schema.name: keys_name
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX keys_name ON keys (tenant, name)

schema.name: proposals_open
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX proposals_open ON proposals (tenant, status, expires_at)

schema.name: audit
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE audit ( seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, at INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, action TEXT NOT NULL, target_type TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, before TEXT, after TEXT)

schema.name: dashboards
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE dashboards ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, head INTEGER NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, intent TEXT NOT NULL, tags TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT, panel_count INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, deleted_by TEXT, purge_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, id))

schema.name: key_secrets
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE key_secrets ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, key_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, secret_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, valid_until INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, key_id))

schema.name: key_usage
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE key_usage ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, hour INTEGER NOT NULL, samples INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, key, hour))

schema.name: keys
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE keys ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, scopes TEXT NOT NULL, key_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER, disabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rotated_at INTEGER, last_used_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, id))

schema.name: outbox
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox ( seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, kv_key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT, expiration INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: proposals
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE proposals ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, dashboard TEXT NOT NULL, base_revision TEXT NOT NULL, base_number INTEGER NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, changes TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, by TEXT NOT NULL, editors TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, resolved_at INTEGER, resolved_by TEXT, reason TEXT, applied_number INTEGER, applied_changes TEXT, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, id))

schema.name: revisions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE revisions ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, dashboard TEXT NOT NULL, number INTEGER NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL, spec TEXT NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, by TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, proposal TEXT, proposed_by TEXT, reverted_to INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, dashboard, number))

schema.name: settings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE settings ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, section TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, section))

schema.name: tenant_meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE tenant_meta (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, k TEXT NOT NULL, v TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, k))

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: audit_no_delete
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the audit log is append-only'); END

schema.name: audit_no_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the audit log is append-only'); END
